note: Shared KAFKA SIGNAL icon sprite. Icons supplement visible text and never replace semantic labels or evidence.

provenance_semantics.verified: A stated verification check has passed; show the verification text and evidence link.
provenance_semantics.pinned-commit: Content or an asset is pinned to a specific immutable commit; display the commit reference.
provenance_semantics.checksum: A digest is recorded for integrity comparison; display or link the digest/evidence.
provenance_semantics.canonical: The referenced item is the declared canonical source within the documented contract; name that source explicitly.
provenance_semantics.external-source: Evidence originates outside the current repository; provide the source label and link.
provenance_semantics.generated: The artifact was generated by a tool or process; identify the generator/provenance when available.
provenance_semantics.human-reviewed: A human review step is recorded; do not equate this with independent verification and show review evidence.

assets.notes: Consumers must keep visible text and evidence links for provenance claims, preserve information when an asset fails to load, pin an immutable Prompt Vault commit, vendor this sprite locally, and must not hotlink mutable main. Existing evidence and source remain generic concepts; the provenance symbols express narrower recorded states.
